_doc: Per-species corrections for the automatic fish rig. dr/pr/vr = dorsal/pectoral/pelvic size as a share of body height; dx/px/vx = where along the body (0 head, 1 tail); dsink/vsink = how deep the fin base sits in the body; plug = body drawn without a head (the closed-eye head is opened and baked on); hs = head scale for plug. eye = [x, y, radius] as a share of the body box, for a body painted with no eye.
